extension.summary: Launches Akasha Aura instead of the native Kodi Home screen at startup.
Lance Akasha Aura a la place de l'accueil Kodi natif au demarrage.
extension.description: Waits for the boot splash/intro to finish, then opens script.akasha.aura so it becomes the effective home screen. The native Kodi Home window still exists underneath (reachable via Back) as a safety net.
Attend la fin du splash/intro de demarrage, puis ouvre script.akasha.aura pour qu'il devienne l'accueil effectif. L'accueil Kodi natif reste accessible en dessous (via Back) comme filet de securite.
